title: A SPA that posts the cart total and the chosen plan to its own API, next to a checkout that sends only a Stripe price id

mustFind.why: The order route receives the total the browser computed.
The profile update carries the plan field.

mustNotFlag.why: Sending a Stripe price id is the right pattern; Stripe prices it.
An ARIA role on a button is not a privilege.
Server code computing an amount is where it belongs.
